questions.title: Never have I ever... pretended to be asleep to avoid a conversation. Have you? Why do you prefer silence over talking?
Never have I ever... read my partner's messages without them knowing. Have you? What made you do it — or what stopped you?
Never have I ever... faked being hurt just to get attention and care. Have you? Did you actually get what you wanted?
Never have I ever... been jealous for no real reason. Have you? What exactly triggered it?
Never have I ever... secretly checked my partner's phone. Have you? Was it justified?
Never have I ever... lied to avoid an argument. Have you? How did that turn out?
Never have I ever... thought about someone else while in a relationship. Have you? Was it serious or fleeting?
Never have I ever... waited in silent resentment for my partner to figure out what was wrong. Have you? Why didn't you just say it?
Never have I ever... pretended everything was fine when I was boiling inside. Have you? What held you back?
Never have I ever... flirted with someone to boost my self-esteem. Have you? Did it help or make things worse?
Never have I ever... regretted words I said during an argument. Have you? What would you change?
Never have I ever... pretended to like something just to avoid hurting my partner. Have you? What was it about?
Never have I ever... stalked an ex on social media. Have you? Why did you do it?
Never have I ever... felt ashamed of my own desires. Have you? What felt uncomfortable about it?
Never have I ever... compared my partner to someone else. Have you? In what way exactly?
Never have I ever... wanted to be alone but been afraid to say it. Have you? Why?
Never have I ever... hidden something important from my past. Have you? Is it still a secret?
Never have I ever... done something out of spite toward my partner. Have you? What drove you to it?
Never have I ever... laughed at something that actually hurt me. Have you? Why didn't you tell the truth?
Never have I ever... fallen in love too fast. Have you? How did that end?
Never have I ever... tried to test my partner's feelings through provocation. Have you? Did it work?
Never have I ever... been so afraid of losing someone that I lost myself. Have you? Was that really the case?
Never have I ever... thought about breaking up but was too scared to act on it. Have you? What stopped you?
Never have I ever... made up an excuse to get out of meeting someone. Have you? What was the real reason?
Never have I ever... been jealous of my partner's friends. Have you? Why them specifically?
Never have I ever... worried about my appearance in front of my partner. Have you? What bothers you about it?
Never have I ever... deliberately ignored messages. Have you? Were you trying to teach a lesson or just exhausted?
Never have I ever... said 'I'm fine' when absolutely nothing was fine. Have you? Why do you hide your emotions?
Never have I ever... had fantasies about someone in my close circle. Have you? Did it affect the relationship?
Never have I ever... done something truly stupid because of emotions. Have you? What was the most embarrassing thing?
Never have I ever... envied other couples. Have you? What feels missing?
Never have I ever... been afraid to open up completely. Have you? What holds you back?
Never have I ever... felt undervalued in a relationship. Have you? Why does that happen?
